structured_output.summary: The change implements Date.prototype.setUTCMilliseconds in its own file and follows the spec steps in order. Step 1 is a manual Object check that throws a TypeError. Step 3 reads the time value via date::this_time_value(agent, this)?, which should perform RequireInternalSlot. Step 4 is ToNumber with ?. Step 5 returns NaN when tv is NaN. Step 6 calls date::make_time with the hour, minute, second and millisecond. Step 7 is time_clip(make_date(day(tv), time)). Step 8 stores the value with date::set_time_value. Step 9 returns the value. Each step has its spec comment directly above its code. No other files are touched. The only redundancy is the explicit Object check before this_time_value, which throws the same TypeError type and has no observable effect. The support::date helpers are not in the diff, so I could not verify that this_time_value does the slot check or that make_time applies ToIntegerOrInfinity to its arguments. The gate's 8 new passing test262 runs are consistent with them being correct.
structured_output.notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. The support::date helpers (this_time_value, make_time, set_time_value) are outside the diff, so their correctness was not checked here. The explicit Object check before this_time_value duplicates the RequireInternalSlot Object check and could be dropped if this_time_value already covers it, but this is optional.
